content:
Priya (ProdMktg): Quick sync: new PLG experiment for webinar leads. Offer = 50 starter credits + a 4-prompt 'Launch Pack' injected in-product. Hypothesis: template + credits increases D7 activation and shortens time-to-first-demo. Need playbook and measurement plan.

Evan (Data): Sounds good. Primary metric = D7 active (>=1 gen). Secondary = time-to-first-completion and median tokens/day. I'll pull last 3 webinar cohorts as baseline and suggest sample size.

Aisha (Growth): Recommend factorial: Credits (50 vs 100) x Pack (pack vs no-pack) x CTA copy ("Start with template" vs "Claim credits"). Keep cells small but we can run for 2 weeks.

Tom - Content: I'll write three micro-copy flows: prereg email, immediate nudge with recording + CTA + 'how-to' modal link, and two follow ups (tips + case mini-story). Will include explicit line about credits expiring in 30 days. ETA Tue midday.

Leif (DevEx): Implementation notes: prompt packs can be injected via internal endpoint. I will add a one-time modal that surfaces when pack is injected with quick usage tips and a CTA to run a sample prompt. Delivery payload example for eng:

POST /internal/packs/inject
{
  "pack": "webinar_launchpack_v1",
  "user_id": "<id>",
  "expires_at": "2026-04-30T23:59:59Z"
}

I'll QA across web + macOS client.

Marco (Growth Ops): Routing: if user consumes >500 tokens OR completes >=5 prompts within 48h => tag high-engage, create CS task, and send DM to AMs. I'll implement via webhook to Zapier and create automations in Salesforce. Need exact event names.

Priya (ProdMktg): Confirm OR logic. Also confirm credits expire in 30 days. We'll surface expiration in subject line and modal.

Evan (Data): I'll add events: webinar_attend, pack_injected, pack_used, tokens_24h, completions_48h. I'll create a dashboard showing cohort performance and lift vs baseline.

Aisha (Growth): Also track top 5 prompts used and retention on those prompts at D14. If a prompt drives retention, we'll bake it into onboarding.

Tom - Content: Subject line options: 1) "Your 50 starter credits + Launch Pack" 2) "Kickstart your demo — templates inside" 3) "Try a ready-made prompt with your credits" Thoughts?

Leif (DevEx): Suggest in-modal CTA = "Run sample now" (runs a safe demo prompt using 1 credit) to reduce friction. Also include a short 'why this prompt works' tooltip.

Marco (Growth Ops): Note on A/B assignment: set flag webinar_launchpack_v2 with three variants. I can coordinate rollout so we don't overlap with other experiments. Also will log cohort tag = webinar_lp_1765.

Priya (ProdMktg): Timeline: copy + modal mock Tue, dev + QA Wed, soft-launch Thu 09:00 PT aligned with webinar followups. Evan please provide baseline numbers by Mon EOD.

Evan (Data): Will do. Also will provide min detectable effect for the split plan.

Aisha (Growth): Let's include a small post-demo survey for users who hit the high-engage threshold: ask "What did you build?" and permission to use as a short case for marketing. If yes, we'll follow up via CSM.

Tom - Content: I'll add that survey copy as optional follow-up microcopy.

Leif (DevEx): I'll instrument a safe-mode for the modal in case injection fails and fall back to a banner + inbox nudge.

Marco (Growth Ops): For the Zapier webhook, I'll need the exact event payload and a sample success/failure retry policy. Will sync with Leif.

Priya (ProdMktg): Final checklist: Tom -> copy + survey, Leif -> injection + modal + QA, Marco -> routing + Zapier + SF handoff, Evan -> dashboard + baseline, Aisha -> experiment design and CTA variants. Launch Thu 09:00 PT.

calendar-bot: Reminder — Webinar scheduled 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. Recording will auto-post 15m after end.

Priya (ProdMktg): Great work team. I'll compile a Loom with the playbook and post back here with links. :rocket:
